description: #272: the EP05 of ep05_td_timetable runs under power under a section insulator: a piece of the overhead wire 1 m long with no supply ("*", 0 V), some 375 m from the start. The pantograph is without voltage for a few hundredths of a second, which the vehicle bridges by holding the last voltage for 0.2 s (TDynamicObject::Update). Without the hold the undervoltage relay would open the line contactors, which on a PantRequiresMain vehicle close again only with the master controller back at its first position: the traction force stays up all the way past the insulator.

vars.consist: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic pkp/ep05_v2 ep05-23 ep05 0 headdriver 0 0 enddynamic
